description: Department of Local Govt. (Western Province) - Chairman Position of Kotikawatte Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha announce that a Meeting 22nd October 2021, 9.30 a.m.
categorisation: This gazette announces the convening of a meeting to select a new Chairman for a local authority (Kotikawatte Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha). The notice is made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically deals with the electoral process for filling a vacated position in local government. This falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it Type 7 (Elections).
